result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual, with aspirational lines led by community and philanthropy; the 'Firm is dedicated' sentence is the main absolute commitment. Voice mixes 'the Firm' and first-person 'we'. Commitments are often hedged ('help reduce'). Most of the page is a dated history and statistics, with little on shareholders despite the banking business.
